defect: raw reset deassertion reaches a functional register without synchronization
rationale: The reduced reset generator leaves the asynchronous rst_ni on the functional register, so release can violate recovery or removal timing.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the bypass reset generator to the functional register that consumes its reset.

mutation.description: Removed the reset pipeline that should precede request_q and retained the raw reset in its sensitivity list.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Port reset asserts and releases asynchronously on request_q with no release synchroniser.
